name: swirl-upgrade
description: Bridge for older installs: adds a 'swirl-upgrade' terminal command that updates the whole system to the latest release.
author: Swirl
title: SwirlOS Upgrade (r61/r62)
tagline: Update an old install in place - keeps your files.
long: Installs from before r63 cannot update themselves: they have no system manifest and an older spm. This package brings the new spm and one terminal command, swirl-upgrade. It compares every system file by content, downloads only what changed, verifies each file and swaps them in safely (a failed update rolls back). Your files in /home/user and your settings are never touched.\nYou must boot a SwirlOS r63+ ISO first - the kernel lives on the boot medium and cannot be updated from inside the OS.
